projects.title: Goal-Based Progress Tracker
projects.logline: A hero tracks his daily battles — one streak, one habit, one small win at a time.
projects.description: Productivity web application that tracks daily goals and maintains an immutable history of completed tasks. Provides a rich dashboard with completion trends, streak analytics, consistency metrics, and progress summaries to help users understand their velocity and stay accountable.

projects.title: AI Voice Therapist — Conversational Support Prototype
projects.logline: When words are hard to say out loud, someone — something — is finally listening.
projects.description: AI voice-based conversational assistant designed for empathetic, supportive one-to-one interactions. Combines speech recognition, conversation context modeling, and emotion-aware response synthesis. Built around therapist-informed conversational principles and structured mental-wellness knowledge to provide a judgment-free sounding board.

projects.title: Hommie's — E-Commerce Platform
projects.logline: A skincare empire built from scratch, one clean line of code at a time.
projects.description: Full frontend e-commerce website for a bespoke skincare brand, built with modular HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Includes catalog browsing, category filtering, responsive product view modals, dynamic cart drawer with quantity toggles, and persistent checkout workflows.

projects.title: Pinterest-Style Web Application
projects.logline: A world of images, endlessly discoverable — built for the scroll that never wants to end.
projects.description: Social-image discovery web application inspired by visual bookmarking platforms. Features an adaptive masonry layout, responsive image cards, modal inspect, collection tagging, and a component-based frontend architecture ready for backend API integration.
